quotes.text: So powerful is the light of unity that it can illuminate the whole earth.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: It is not for him to pride himself who loveth his own country, but rather for him who loveth the whole world. The earth is but one country, and mankind its citizens.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: The diversity in the human family should be the cause of love and harmony, as it is in music where many different notes blend together in the making of a perfect chord.
quotes.author: 'Abdu'l-Bahá

quotes.text: When a thought of war comes, oppose it by a stronger thought of peace. A thought of hatred must be destroyed by a more powerful thought of love.
quotes.author: 'Abdu'l-Bahá

quotes.text: Do not be content with showing friendship in words alone, let your heart burn with loving kindness for all who may cross your path.
quotes.author: 'Abdu'l-Bahá

quotes.text: O Son of Being! Love Me, that I may love thee. If thou lovest Me not, My love can in no wise reach thee. Know this, O servant.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Being! My love is My stronghold; he that entereth therein is safe and secure, and he that turneth away shall surely stray and perish.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Spirit! The best beloved of all things in My sight is Justice; turn not away therefrom if thou desirest Me, and neglect it not that I may confide in thee. By its aid thou shalt see with thine own eyes and not through the eyes of others, and shalt know of thine own knowledge and not through the knowledge of thy neighbor.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Spirit! My first counsel is this: Possess a pure, kindly and radiant heart, that thine may be a sovereignty ancient, imperishable and everlasting.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Spirit! Noble have I created thee, yet thou hast abased thyself. Rise then unto that for which thou wast created.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Man! Rejoice in the gladness of thine heart, that thou mayest be worthy to meet Me and to mirror forth My beauty.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Son of Being! Bring thyself to account each day ere thou art summoned to a reckoning; for death, unheralded, shall come upon thee and thou shalt be called to give account for thy deeds.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: O Befriended Stranger! The candle of thine heart is lighted by the hand of My power, quench it not with the contrary winds of self and passion. The healer of all thine ills is remembrance of Me, forget it not. Make My love thy treasure and cherish it even as thy very sight and life.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: Be generous in prosperity, and thankful in adversity. Be worthy of the trust of thy neighbor, and look upon him with a bright and friendly face.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: Be ye loving fathers to the orphan, and a refuge to the helpless, and a treasury for the poor, and a cure for the ailing.
quotes.author: 'Abdu'l-Bahá

quotes.text: Let your vision be world-embracing, rather than confined to your own self.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: The essence of faith is fewness of words and abundance of deeds.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: Regard man as a mine rich in gems of inestimable value. Education can, alone, cause it to reveal its treasures, and enable mankind to benefit therefrom.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá'u'lláh

quotes.text: If a man engageth with all his power in the acquisition of a science or in the perfection of an art, it is as if he has been worshipping God in churches and temples.
quotes.author: 'Abdu'l-Bahá

quotes.text: The steed of this Valley is patience; without patience the wayfarer on this journey will reach nowhere and attain no goal.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
quotes.source: The Seven Valleys and the Four Valleys

quotes.text: The Word of God is the king of words and its pervasive influence is incalculable.
quotes.author: Bahá'u'lláh
